description: CTL-1 logs response payload one byte over the 65536-byte semantic ceiling. The transport (16 MiB JW_IPC_MAX_FRAME) happily carries this frame; contracts.md is explicit that CTL-1/LIFE-1 treat anything past 64 KiB as a protocol error regardless. This is not a JSON-shape defect -- the payload is otherwise a perfectly valid logs_response -- so an implementation that only schema-validates shape and never checks payload size would wrongly accept it.
